name: Ottweiler (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Ottweiler (a red castle above a white rose on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Ottweiler; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ottweiler arms — castle and rose on blue
